versions.changelog:
- No file changes detected in this release.
- No user-facing changes; binaries and documentation remain unchanged.
- Version incremented to 1.0.1 for release tracking purposes only.

Initial release of the AgentPMT Blockchain Scanner tool skill.

- Enables querying EVM blockchain data across Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum, and Optimism.
- Supports balance checks (up to 20 addresses), paginated transaction history, EIP-1559 gas oracle info, and contract ABI retrieval.
- Integrates with AgentPMT’s credit-based payment model (buy credits with x402 or earn via jobs).
- Includes session management, wallet signature flow, and request signing details.
- Detailed instructions for credit acquisition and wallet setup provided.
- Public API endpoints specified for all operations.
